# HexPiece 3.6.9

The Phoenix fruit is now in the game, plus your newest Buzz Cut note. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 13 test suites
pass, and the phoenix, its flames and its transformation were rendered in previews.

## Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix (Mythical, Zoan)
Your words: "Mythical Fruit: Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix Zoan Type. I made the model ... Z (transforms/detransforms)" and
"continue".
- A new fruit item: a round fruit of blue fire with a golden crown of flame. It is ranked Mythical.
- **Z** transforms you into your phoenix model, with the animations from the previews. The wingspan is about 7 blocks, and the whole
  body is moving blue and gold fire.
- Press **Z** again to turn back. After turning back there is a 3-second cooldown before the next transformation. There is no meter,
  as you chose.
- **The transformation:** blue fire bursts out of you and spirals up round you while a ring of flame runs out over the ground. The
  phoenix opens up out of the fire. Turning back, the flames spiral back into your chest and go out with a last flare.
- **Flying:** as the phoenix you can fly, a little faster than creative flight. The bird flaps harder the faster you go, glides
  when you keep a steady speed, sweeps its wings back when you dive, and perches with gentle wingbeats when you land. It banks into
  your turns, and its flames stream back in the wind.
- **Camera:** the camera goes to third person and pulls back to fit the bird. Turning back returns you to first person if that is
  where you were.
- Water turns the phoenix back. Your normal flight settings come back when the phoenix goes, and also on death, logging out,
  changing worlds or a crash. You take no fall damage while you are the phoenix, or for a moment after.
- The moves (Fujiazami, Talon Slam / Hawk Rush, Phoenix Inferno, Bluebird) come next, after you have seen it.

## Buzz Cut: only the arm swings
Your words: "the arm spinning looks super weird, the body of the player is not meant to move at all, its only the right arm".
Through the whole Buzz Cut (both versions), your body now stays still, facing the way it was when the move caught. Only the right
arm swings the giant fist round from the shoulder.
